description: This file contains Windows-specific file utility functions for file operations such as delete, replace, check existence, create temporary files/directories, and path normalization, primarily used within the Chromium project.

methods.name: MakeAbsoluteFilePath
methods.description: Converts a relative file path to an absolute path using _wfullpath.

methods.name: DeleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory, with optional recursion.

methods.name: DeleteFileAfterReboot
methods.description: Schedules a file to be deleted after system reboot.

methods.name: ReplaceFile
methods.description: Replaces one file with another, with retries for race conditions.

methods.name: PathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists.

methods.name: PathIsWritable
methods.description: Checks if a given path is writable.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: GetTempDir
methods.description: Retrieves the system temporary directory.

methods.name: CreateAndOpenTemporaryFileInDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in a specified directory with a GUID-based name.

methods.name: CreateTemporaryDirInDir
methods.description: Creates a new temporary directory with a GUID-based name inside a base directory.

methods.name: CreateNewTempDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new temporary directory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: CreateDirectoryAndGetError
methods.description: Creates a directory and its parent directories if needed, returning error info.

methods.name: NormalizeFilePath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to its native form, converting device paths to drive letter paths.

methods.name: DevicePathToDriveLetterPath
methods.description: Converts a device NT path to a drive letter path if possible.

methods.name: NormalizeToNativeFilePath
methods.description: Converts a path to its native NT device path.

methods.name: IsLink
methods.description: Stub function, always returns false; placeholder for link detection.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file attributes and times for a given file path.

methods.name: OpenFile
methods.description: Opens a file with specified mode, adding 'N' flag for native mode.

methods.name: FileToFILE
methods.description: Converts a File object to a FILE* stream.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads data from a file into a buffer.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file.

methods.name: AppendToFile
methods.description: Appends data to an existing file.

methods.name: GetCurrentDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the current working directory.

methods.name: SetCurrentDirectory
methods.description: Sets the current working directory.

methods.name: GetMaximumPathComponentLength
methods.description: Gets maximum filename component length for a volume.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode.
